Publication

Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment
Substitute Narrative, Analysis and Plans
5616 North Washtenaw Avenue
B3-2 District to B2-3 District (Type 1)

WASHTENAW CHICAGO APTS LLC is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject
property located at 5616 North Washtenaw Avenue from the B3-2 Community Shopping District to the B2-
3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District (Type 1) to restore the existing residential development to a conforming
use and allow a renovation of the existing 3-story residential building with 20 residential units. The 1960's
era building was previously converted from commercial to residential use. The requested zoning change
will bring the ground floor residential units, residential density, and on-site parking conditions into conformity
with Zoning.

The site is bounded by commercial property to the north, North Washtenaw Avenue to the east, a 16-foot
public alley on the south, and a 16-foot public alley to the west. The subject property consists of
approximately 7,938.5 square feet of site area and is improved with an existing residential building. The
existing building contains approximately 11,913 square feet of floor area and has been operated as a
residential building for nearly five decades. The property is a transit-served location based on its proximity
to the Lincoln CTA bus line corridor roadway segment.

The Applicant proposes to renovate the existing building to upgrade aged and substandard components of
the structure. The number of dwelling units in the building and the building footprint will remain unchanged.
The proposed renovation will include the addition of 10 bicycle parking spaces on site.
